about: I'm a Computer Science (AI & Data Science) student at Pimpri Chinchwad University, Pune, graduating in 2027. I currently work as a Data Analyst Intern at Krios Info Solutions, where I design Tableau and Power BI dashboards for enterprise clients and build the Python and SQL pipelines behind them.

Outside work I build end-to-end projects: real-time analytics dashboards, anomaly detection services packaged with Docker, and agentic AI applications using LLMs, retrieval (RAG) and workflow automation. I enjoy taking a project from raw data all the way to a deployed app that people can actually use.
I'm looking for opportunities in data analytics, data engineering and applied AI, where I can work on real business problems and keep learning from experienced teams.

contact.message: Whether it's an internship, a full-time role or a project collaboration, I'd love to hear from you. The quickest way to reach me is email or LinkedIn.
